Policy activity register

HOW TO READ THIS REGISTER

One action, one record. Every claim has a source.

What qualifies

A named state-government action with an explicit AI component: policy, funding, institutions, partnerships, deployment or safeguards. Private investment alone, generic digitisation and Union-only programmes are excluded.

How dates work

The displayed date is the event date, not automatically the article date. Month-only dates remain month-only. Unknown dates are marked explicitly and sorted after dated records. Evidence panels explain the date decision.

How duplicates work

Multiple sources for the same action attach to one record. Approval, notification and deployment can remain separate milestones. Similar titles only trigger review; they do not cause automatic merging.

What this cannot establish

This is a purposive, mainly English-web sample. A source can verify an announcement without proving delivery, expenditure, safety or benefit. Fewer records do not mean less activity.
